comparator_search.method: Case-insensitive directed keyword search; operator probe requires -ge/-lt adjacent to a numeric version literal, preventing -Generation and $PSVersionTable noise.
comparator_search.scope: scripts/, plugins/, templates/, install.ps1, uninstall.ps1, source/registry/

comparator_search_hits.rationale: Keyword hit only; no comparison expression on this line.

comparator_search_hits.context: throw ('runtime versions registry: ' + $group + '.' + $key + ' com version fora do semver exato (esperado ' + $verPattern + '; rejeita latest/range/^/~/espaco): ' + $ver + ' em ' + $path)
